_about: Route presets and the default scenario for the route engine (PROMPT.md 5.3 and 5.9). Every value is PLACEHOLDER unless a source is given. Weights multiply the terms of the edge cost c(e) = dt [w_t + w_m M/M_nom + w_r R + w_d D + w_u U]; value_weight is what one unit of science value is worth in weighted minutes when a station is skipped.

eva_max_min.label: PLACEHOLDER
eva_max_min.note: Longest EVA allowed, staging to staging.

consumables_total_min.label: PLACEHOLDER
consumables_total_min.note: Consumables at the start, in minutes at the nominal metabolic rate.

buddy_min_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
buddy_min_m.note: The overwatch point is at least this far from the station.

sample_step_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
sample_step_m.source: PROMPT.md 5.9: checked at least every 5 m

max_station_distance_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
max_station_distance_m.note: Candidate stations lie within this distance of the staging point.

candidate_stations.label: PLACEHOLDER
candidate_stations.note: Highest-scoring valid stations kept for the leg matrix.

grid_margin_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
grid_margin_m.note: Planning grid extends this far beyond the farthest candidate.

planning_resolution_m.label: PLACEHOLDER
planning_resolution_m.source: PROMPT.md 5.1: a 2 m level for long legs
